description.value:
You reach into the mind of a non-hostile creature within range, subtly nudging its feelings toward you. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become swayed for the power's duration, granting you advantage on Charisma checks made against it.

If the target succeeds, it doesn't realize you attempted to influence it, but it can't be affected by this power again for 24 hours. Droids and constructs are unaffected entirely.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, At-Will
